name: mail-date-format-monday
description: A partner changes its order date format on Monday and wants a confirmation by Friday: the user must decide, and OcuTalon cannot check or change it, so the user is told now.

item.subject: Order date format changes on Monday
item.text: Hello, starting Monday our orders carry the order date as dd/MM/yyyy instead of yyyy-MM-dd. Please confirm by Friday that your system accepts the new format, or tell us if you need more time. Thanks, Order Partner Operations
